description: Confirm the person's exact item/quantity. source_text (max 1,000 chars): their brand/model words on a separate line or in double quotes, or their product link. Site normaliser; no inference. user_confirmed attests choices/terms. Needs update + purchases:irreversible, not agent_judgement. Auth supplies audit identity. No agent freshness renewal, pause clearing or buying authority.

delivery_methods.description: Delivery the user accepts: shipping, pickup or both.

expected_version.description: The Request version you last read.

product_url.description: The product page the user named.

request_key.description: Your key for this change; the same key repeats it safely.

source_text.description: The user's own words or link naming the item.

user_confirmed.description: True: the user said yes to this exact change.

variant.description: Optional size, color or version the user named.

name: confirm_future_purchase_item

result.description: The Request after the change: the fields to act on are listed here. The result is the full Request (or its overview, as request_format chose); get_future_purchase lists its full shape.

may_commit_declared_at.description: When the owner or their agent declared that the owner is ready to buy from an Offer if one fits; null when not declared. A recorded statement, never a permission Popular Demand grants or verifies.

questions_emailed.description: Whether questions about this Request are emailed to the user. False while email updates for it are off: tell the user they could miss an offer, and answer questions you receive.

possible_duplicate_of.description: Open Requests of the same owner that closely match this new one: the same exact product references, the same top Need option set or the same words, with an overlapping destination. The new Request was saved anyway. If one is the same purchase, update or close the extra Request so the user is counted once.

title: Confirm the exact item
